definition: Synthesia Limited is a British multinational artificial intelligence company based in London, United Kingdom.
details: It is a synthetic media-generation software developer and creator of AI-generated video content, including audio-visual agents and cloned avatars. Britain's largest generative-AI firm, it is used by 70% of FTSE 100 and over 90% of Fortune 100 companies.

explainer.lead: Synthesia is a London-based AI company making software that generates video content, including cloned avatars and audio-visual agents. It matters as Britain's largest generative-AI firm by its reported reach into major corporations.

tiers.eli5: It's a company that builds videos of talking avatars for you, so you don't need a camera or an actor.
tiers.practitioner: Teams use it to produce training and corporate videos with avatars; a practical concern is ensuring avatar and voice outputs are clearly labelled as AI-generated rather than mistaken for real footage.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition applies; it is a commercial entity whose product is synthetic media generation, and claims about customer share come from the company's own reporting.

explainer.example: A firm needing a multilingual onboarding video can generate it with an avatar speaking several languages instead of filming each version.
